query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

parts.text:
*(Steps onto the capstan, looking down at the gathered crew with a fierce, gold-toothed grin. Leans heavily on a cutlass, letting the silence stretch for a moment before speaking in a low, rumbling growl that carries over the creaking of the ship’s timbers.)*

"Gather 'round, ye beautiful, scurvy dogs, and lend me yer ears! 

I see the weariness in yer eyes. I know the salt has bitten deep into yer skin, that the fresh water is running low, and the hardtack has gone soft with weevils. I know ye’ve been looking out at this endless blue horizon, wondering if we’re chasing nothing but ghosts and sea spray.

But look at yourselves! Look at the scars ye wear like badges of honor. We are the terror of the Spanish Main! We are the crew of the *[Ship's Name, e.g., Black Albatross]*, and we do not bow to kings, we do not beg for scraps, and we do *not* give up when the prize is within our grasp!

*(Pulls a weathered, salt-stained parchment from inside a leather coat and holds it high)*

Do ye see this? This ain't just ink on sheepskin. This is the key to the Hoard of the Obsidian Coast. Whispered of in every dark tavern from Tortuga to Port Royal, but never found. Until now. 

Beneath the roots of the weeping mangroves, buried deep in the black sand of an island that maps forgot, lies a treasure that would make the King of Spain himself look like a pauper. Chests bursting with golden doubloons, rubies as red as the blood of our enemies, and silver goblets we’ll use to toast our victories! 

Think of what that gold buys ye, lads! No more dodging the Royal Navy's noose for a pocketful of copper. No more sleeping on damp hammocks. With this hoard, every man jack of ye will live like a lord. Ye’ll buy yer own islands, ye'll drink the finest rum from golden cups, and the world will whisper yer names in awe and terror until the seas run dry!

Aye, they say the island is cursed. They say the jungle eats men alive and the dead guard the chests. But I ask ye this: since when did a bunch of rotting bones scare a crew that has sailed through the belly of a hurricane? Since when did a few shadows stop men of iron? We’ve sent the King's galleons to the locker, and we've laughed in the face of Davy Jones himself! Let the dead try to stop us—we’ll just show 'em how we kill what’s already gone!

So, who is with me? Who wants to rot on a leaking tub, and who wants to carve their name into the very fabric of history? 

Sharpen yer cutlasses! Prime yer pistols! Raise the anchor and let the wind rip! Today, we don't just hunt for gold—we sail to claim our destiny! 

To the island, ye scoundrels! *Drink up me 'earties, yo ho!*"
